scope: Android client only; existing server and Windows layout retained
reference: User-provided f7f3c9c6f5b72193b9f085bd3d89a963.jpg, two light blue mobile mail screens
direction: Frosted blue and lilac, rounded mailbox tiles, avatar message rows, floating bottom navigation
referenceOverrides: Soft gradient summary tiles and background
Four functional count tiles, no decorative charts
Reference uses colored circular folder icons and a prominent 36px overview title

screens.overview: Which folder in this account needs my attention?
screens.inbox: Which email should I read or act on next?
screens.reader: What does this message say and how can I respond?
screens.accounts: Which server-backed account am I using?
screens.compose: Who am I writing to, and has my draft been saved?

data.counts: GET /api/client/mailbox, current account only; missing folder is zero; not loaded is an em dash
data.messages: Existing paginated server API; unread and starred filters run on the server
data.avatars: Local initials and deterministic color; no third-party avatar requests
data.preview: Isolated test fixture with fictional accounts, never packaged in APK

interaction: Native Back closes dialogs, then reader, then inbox, then backgrounds app
Reduced motion and system dark theme
performance: No new dependencies, images or fonts. Only the small bottom navigation uses blur; message rows use static fills. Existing 30-message pagination and search debounce retained.

reviewExceptions.icon-chips: Four folder icons reproduce the explicitly requested reference; each names a working shortcut
reviewExceptions.app-title-size: 36px overview title follows the reference; all other section headings remain compact
reviewExceptions.shadow: Very faint tile edges match the reference; strongest shadows are on real modal and navigation overlays
reviewExceptions.glass: Only the small fixed navigation blurs its background

nativeVerification: Build and signature checks plus isolated browser interaction tests; physical Android device acceptance remains pending.
